Your plan, live in four steps.

STEP 01

Choose your space

Tell us how much you store, in bins, pallets or m², from 300 zł per m². The price shows before you commit, not after a sales call.

STEP 02

Add the services you need

Fulfillment, returns and import. Tap to add each one and the price updates, and each one can come off again.

STEP 03

Choose how you sell

Open your own .pl store, or join 2ACE Market and pay a commission only when something sells. Add either one later.

STEP 04

Sign, pay and go live

Review your plan, sign online and pay securely. Then track imports, stock and orders from one login.

Coverage

One hub in Poland reaches the whole market.

Sitting in the middle of Europe is the cheapest advantage in logistics. Road freight leaves daily and most of the continent is a two to four day promise.
